issue-4403: Is the byte order mark at the start of CSV exports deliberate?
Opened by warehouse-etl-ken on 2026-10-20

Our Python loader reads the first column of every Ledgerline CSV as `\ufeffDate`
instead of `Date`. A hex viewer shows the bytes EF BB BF at the start of the
file. Is that on purpose

args.title: Clarify CSV export byte order mark behavior
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The byte order mark (BOM) in CSV exports is deliberate, as documented in src/export/csv.ts where `bom = true` is set by default to help spreadsheet applications detect UTF-8 when opening CSV files directly. No code change is required for this question.
